title: Looking for Feedback on UI, UX, SFX
author: No_Elk_8930
selftext:
I am looking for feedback on the UI and UX of my Reversi like game.

If you want to try it out, go here [Free Play ](http://nextoath.ai/practice)(login required).  
[documentation](https://nextoath.ai/help/strategy) if you are feeling lost

Why is the map so dark?  Maps are generated dynamically from world building, and this one had a gritty slick art style.

Feedback I'm seeking?

1.  Huh?  Why'd you do it that way, it would be better if ...  
2.  Blah sfx when I capture is great/awful?  Why not ....  
3.  You need to break this out into a separate standalone game for mobile?  
4.  You need to add ....  
  
Built with:  
Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor  
Uses:  
gemini-2.5-flash
